entries.title: RP OS 0.2.1
added: Added focused anti-cheat popup interfaces for online players, known identities, flagged players, grey-screened profiles, active locks, and recent evidence.
Added search and direct player-intelligence drill-down inside every anti-cheat summary popup.
Added a dedicated Settlement Operations tab to Developer Tools with a live animated execution console.
Added batch driver-license suspension for unpaid fines with automatic player notifications.
Added an animated FNN generation console showing source scanning, model generation, validation, completion, and errors.
Added independent Dev Tools intake controls for every government, legal, emergency-services, and FNN application.
Rebuilt the anti-cheat player popup as a continuous intelligence dossier with platform identity, telemetry assessment, evidence, and alternate-account records.
Added dedicated Auto Pilot and System Update workspaces inside Developer Tools.
Added a Faircroft-branded limited-service update experience that preserves essential resident and authorized public-safety access.
Added a full-width Faircroft Administration workspace with an operational overview, identity-readiness ledger, searchable resident directory, and direct account-file controls.
Expanded the FNN newsroom source archive to include court petitions, license suspensions, criminal warrants, wanted-person BOLOs, and reporter-submitted Press Desk stories.
Added an official Faircroft Judiciary order treatment and digital court seal to the findings workflow.
Added a restricted DMV Settings workspace in Developer Tools for suspending, revoking, expiring, restoring, classifying, and endorsing driver credentials.
Added configurable primary license classes and endorsements with resident credential display.
Added statewide Mark All Expired and Mark All Revoked controls with typed confirmation, audit history, and resident notifications.
Added optional driver-license restoration fees that enter Settlement Operations as DMV administrative charges for the manual midnight deduction process.
Added mandatory Faircroft DMV entrance notices for license suspension, revocation, and expiration that appear immediately on login or refresh and require resident acknowledgement.
Added Admin account enforcement controls for CAD timeouts, suspensions, temporary bans, permanent bans, and separate Arma server bans.
Added a dedicated Developer Tools Admin 2FA workspace with expiring single-use authorization codes and an audited usage ledger.
Added an Admin Chat-only resident experience while RP OS/CAD access is restricted.
Added live linked-account search in Developer Tools across resident name, email, CIV number, in-game name, and Bohemia identity.
Added a Beta-only Download Our App icon with dedicated PWA, Windows desktop, and Android APK release locations.
Added an audited Developer Tools emergency control that resets every active Arma account link and notifies affected residents to reconnect with a new code.
Added a guarded Developer Tools game-economy migration control that clears stale Railway FCRPMUSSALO balance snapshots while preserving links, CAD records, fines, taxes, and settlement history.
changed: Consolidated the current platform work into the RP OS 0.2.1 release.
Converted the Anti-Cheat dashboard metrics from passive counters into interactive operational controls.
Moved Fine Settlement out of the phone application grid and into the restricted Developer Tools workspace.
Forced fine-removal authorization now requires all affected driver licenses to be suspended first.
Closed job applications now keep their advertisement visible while disabling only that posting's application form.
Replaced the anti-cheat popup's oversized widget grid with a compact professional ledger layout.
Removed driver-license auto approval so every license requires the scored DMV examination.
Removed System Settings from the phone application grid and separated automation from release controls.
Moved Admin out of the simulated phone and aligned its navigation, records layout, and responsive behavior with the Developer Tools staff workspace.
Removed Job Applications from Admin; recruitment review remains in the dedicated Indeed Admin workflow.
Retired Referral Tickets from Admin, resident profiles, and new-account registration while preserving historical database records.
Advanced the visible RP OS release designation and PWA installation cache to version 0.2.1.
Press Desk stories are now marked Included after a successful Gemini edition so reporters can confirm newsroom collection.
Standardized citation and criminal findings as Guilty or Not Guilty instead of the retired Liable or Not Liable language.
Driver-license administrative controls now live under Developer Tools > DMV Settings rather than the resident DMV application.
Separated website/CAD restrictions from Arma enforcement so CAD actions never alter a linked game account.
Limited Admin 2FA requirements to permanent CAD bans and both temporary and permanent Arma bans.
Reworked linked-account popup records into a continuous intelligence dossier with expandable record ledgers instead of stacked widget cards.
Consolidated installation controls into one Faircroft Beta download center and retired the unrelated global install banner.
Routed Windows and Android package buttons through Beta-protected Faircroft download endpoints so installer clicks begin directly without exposing storage links in the interface.
fixed: Fixed the mobile Arma unlink dialog being constrained by the animated profile panel and overlapping Recent Link Claims.
Contained the unlink guidance, authorization field, acknowledgment, and confirmation action within a responsive single-column mobile dialog.
Restored the missing Developer Tools linked-account API response that caused Recent Arma Link records to display Request failed.
Expanded Arma event ingestion compatibility for alternate event wrappers, casing, identity fields, timestamps, and numeric payload values.
Made /link/arma a dedicated PWA deep link that opens Profile directly on Game Link, with optional link-code prefilling through the code query parameter.
Fixed the Court Lawyer Licenses tab failing to open because its examination packet renderer referenced the wrong parser.
Fixed Admin being constrained to a narrow phone frame with oversized stacked account cards.
Fixed retired referral rewards continuing to create staff tickets and player notifications during account registration.
Fixed submitted FNN Press Desk stories appearing uncollected even after they were supplied to Gemini.
Fixed final Guilty, Not Guilty, and Dismissal orders requesting or retaining a future court date instead of moving immediately to the Completed docket.
Fixed DMV status changes lacking a controlled restoration-fee route into the existing Settlement desk.
Fixed administrative timeouts and suspensions sharing the developer game-ban path instead of using a website-only CAD restriction.
Fixed Command Overview and Account Linking records presenting inconsistent account-detail interfaces.
Fixed the DMV vehicle-compliance notice exceeding mobile viewports and trapping users before its action controls.
Fixed DMV compliance actions being hidden behind mobile browser navigation and device safe areas.
Fixed Press Desk story submission remaining frozen while waiting for a secondary archive refresh.
Fixed successfully filed press briefs not appearing immediately in the reporter archive even though the newsroom had accepted them.
Fixed Press Desk submissions failing before database insertion because press reports were omitted from the approved record-number generator.
Fixed Fire MDT retaining desktop-width navigation, controls, incident rows, and telemetry sizing on mobile devices.
Updated the PWA asset cache so the repaired Press Desk and responsive Fire MDT load immediately after deployment.
Game-bank snapshot resets now place affected PWA accounts into Awaiting sync until the new Arma database reports their current balances.

entries.title: FNN Press Team Directory
added: Added a Press Team Directory to Developer Tools under FNN Settings.
Added live Press-role holder details including account identity, CIV number, verification status, and Arma-link status.
Added direct access from each Press Team row to the existing developer account record.
Added developer controls to suspend, reinstate, or revoke Press Passes with an official reason.
Added mandatory account notices and inbox messages so affected Press members are informed at their next login.
changed: FNN Press Pass usage now includes the underlying role-holder roster instead of displaying only an issued-pass count.
Suspended Press Passes retain their credential record but cannot open Press Desk until reinstated.
fixed: Improved Arma bridge link-request compatibility with alternate payload wrappers, field casing, timestamp fields, and identity field names.
Normalized link-code spacing and dash characters during bridge ingestion and account claiming.
Fixed newly reissued Press Passes retaining an older revoked or suspended state.

entries.title: Newcomer Field Guide
added: Added a six-stage first-day route covering account linking, starter transportation, stick collection, bag storage, the IL mining license, shovel purchasing, mining, smelting, and ore sales.
Added current in-game map images for the Used Car dealership, Kotka collection route, Bag and Phone Store, Town Hall, Hardware Store, Mining Site, and Smeltery.
Added direct stage selection, previous and next controls, progress tracking, and route restart controls.
changed: Rebuilt Getting Started as a dedicated full-screen field guide instead of displaying it inside the simulated phone.
Desktop now gives route maps and instructions a full records-workspace layout while phones use a true single-column guide.
fixed: Fixed route images being compressed into unusable vertical strips.
Fixed the desktop layout responding to the browser width instead of the narrow phone container.
Removed the retired Getting Started image set.

entries.title: DMV Vehicle Intelligence & Compliance
added: Added automatic DMV intake for vehicles detected through a resident's linked FCRPMUSSALO Arma profile.
Added imported make, model, year, color, generated plate, VIN, registration status, insurance status, and source tracking.
Added a next-login compliance notice when a detected vehicle still requires registration confirmation or insurance.
Added linked vehicle records to the resident Profile overview and NCIC-accessible DMV history.
Added a full-screen fleet dashboard with detected, filed, road-legal, and action-required totals.
Added a ten-question Class D roleplay driver examination with an 8/10 passing score, automatic license issuance, and a 48-hour hold after three consecutive failures.
changed: Rebuilt DMV as a full-screen Motor Vehicle Authority records desk with an official credential, compliance ledger, examination workspace, and vehicle registry.
Confirming imported vehicle identity now activates its registration while insurance remains a separate required action.
Manual vehicle intake remains available for vehicles not present in the linked game profile.
fixed: Fixed vehicle registration and insurance controls being bound to the Court workspace instead of DMV.
Fixed linked game vehicles appearing as informational records without becoming actionable DMV files.
Fixed the previous DMV identity view using excessive generic cards and unused space.

entries.title: Press Desk & FNN Recruitment
added: Added a dedicated Press role, Press Desk app, and structured newsroom report submission workflow.
Added detailed press reports as an eligible source for Faircroft News Now editions.
Added an FNN-branded job application and ten-question press roleplay examination.
Added automatic Press Pass issuance for applicants who pass the internal examination requirement.
Added developer-controlled Press Pass capacity settings and newsroom application intake controls.
changed: Press Desk now opens as a full-screen newsroom dashboard instead of a phone-sized form.
FNN publishing controls are restricted to Developer Tools settings rather than the public newsroom.
fixed: Improved newsroom generation feedback when Gemini quota or model availability prevents publishing.
Updated FNN navigation, story interactions, animations, and mobile article flow.

entries.title: Legal Careers & Court Licensing
added: Added revised Faircroft Bar examinations and internal passing evaluation.
Added Faircroft Prosecutor's Office and Public Defender Office recruitment applications.
Added a judicial license docket for reviewing examinations and approving lawyer certificates.
Added judicial certificate signatures before a successful Bar candidate receives an active lawyer license.
Added continued-hearing date controls that publish the new court date to the resident's Court tab.
changed: Lawyer examinations remain available through Indeed while completed examinations route to Court and authorized administration.
Court, rather than Indeed administration, is the final authority for lawyer licensing.

entries.title: Recruitment & Application Controls
added: Added developer settings for opening or closing public job application intake.
Added an official Faircroft Government applications-closed notice when intake is disabled.
Added separate Sheriff, combined Fire and EMS, legal, and FNN recruitment paths.
changed: Sheriff is now the remaining public law-enforcement application department.
Fire and EMS recruitment is combined into one application route.
Indeed job advertisements use focused open-and-apply panels instead of one long application page.
fixed: Restored the Indeed job icon and protected public job access from unrelated visibility settings.
removed: Removed State Police and Metro Police from public recruitment.

entries.title: Responsive Workspaces & Campaign Operations
added: Added an Active Campaigns area in Developer Tools for promotional banners and entrance splash experiences.
Added campaign enablement, scheduling, media, message, and expiration controls for community announcements, events, organizations, and rule changes.
changed: Developer Tools, FNN, Court, Press Desk, DMV, and Getting Started use dedicated responsive workspaces rather than congested phone layouts.
Mobile safe-area handling and RP OS footer placement were updated for different device heights.
fixed: Fixed published splash experiences appearing immediately to the publisher but not reliably on the next entrance.
Fixed nested scrolling and desktop-width content appearing zoomed or clipped on mobile devices.
Removed static MDT citation and booking metric tiles from the mobile terminal header.

entries.title: System Communications
added: Added developer-published system banners with informational, success, warning, and critical presentation.
Added configurable cinematic splash screens supporting Faircroft-hosted or HTTPS images and videos.
Added Beta Program authorization for Windows desktop installer access.
changed: Desktop downloads now require an authenticated Faircroft Beta Program account.

entries.title: Resident Identity
added: Added dedicated Overview, Characters, Game Link, and Account workspaces to the resident profile.
Added a persistent resident credential header with live verification and game-link status.
changed: Rebuilt the Profile experience to eliminate the long single-page widget stack while preserving every existing account control.

entries.title: Faircroft Financial
added: Added the Faircroft Credit Index, a 300–850 roleplay score derived from persistent MedicalHUD reputation.
Added separate live sync details for authoritative in-game bank balances and reputation.
changed: Rebuilt the Bank app as a premium Faircroft consumer-banking experience.
Removed the retired Railway transaction ledger from the Bank app.

entries.title: Fire & EMS Command System
added: Introduced dedicated Incident Board, Apparatus, and Personnel workspaces for Fire and EMS.
Added live response metrics, active and cleared incident separation, apparatus availability, and crew assignments.
Added an adaptive emergency-services command interface for desktop, tablet, and phone.
changed: Rebuilt Fire MDT and Fire Settings into one consistent professional command environment.

entries.title: Faircroft News Now
added: Introduced FNN, a full-screen daily roleplay newsroom generated from eligible police after-action reports.
Added lead stories, public-safety briefs, secondary coverage, daily archives, and developer-controlled publishing.
Added an original Faircroft broadcast identity and responsive newspaper-style presentation.
changed: Daily reporting excludes evidence links, internal identifiers, and confidential staff material from newsroom generation.

entries.title: Persistent Game Intelligence
added: Added a read-only FCRPMUSSALO intelligence index for characters, vehicles, criminal records, items, police reports, root collections, turrets, and cop chats.
Added account-level persistent record matching with explicit direct and payload confidence labels.
Added a dedicated Game Intelligence command dashboard and detailed linked-account evidence views.
changed: Reworked Dev Tools navigation and linked-account profiles around professional game-data investigation workflows.
Clarified that native persistence supplies current state while historical transactions remain limited to Railway-recorded events.

entries.title: Faircroft Operations Release
added: Released the integrated Court, MDT/CAD, Developer Operations, and Anti-Cheat platform workflow as PWA 0.1.1.
changed: Updated the visible RP OS version and installation cache to the 0.1.1 release line.

entries.title: Anti-Cheat System Telemetry
added: Added reported player-system storage from anti-cheat platform, playerPlatform, platformName, system, and deviceType telemetry fields.
Added system badges to the Anti-Cheat directory and intelligence profile.
Added an Anti-Cheat Reported System section to linked-user backend profiles.
changed: Verified Arma platform data is used as a fallback when the anti-cheat record does not report a system.
Unknown systems are labeled honestly instead of being inferred.

entries.title: Anti-Cheat Directory Restoration
changed: Restored the Anti-Cheat board to its established intelligence-directory layout.
Recent bridge presence can still mark an individual player as live inside their anti-cheat record.
removed: Removed the separate Active Players roster, A2S query, connection warnings, and A2S environment settings.

entries.title: Authoritative A2S Player Roster
added: Added an independent Steam A2S live-player query for the Shadow Haven server.
Added visible roster-source health and connection errors to the Anti-Cheat board.
changed: A2S player results take priority over optional anti-cheat heartbeat events.
Live names are matched back to anti-cheat intelligence and linked CAD accounts when available.
fixed: The active-player count no longer depends exclusively on game-mod heartbeat events.

entries.title: Live Player Presence Compatibility
added: Added support for join, heartbeat, presence, disconnect, and leave events across both bridge Action and EventType fields.
changed: Expanded the default live-presence window to 15 minutes for servers with less-frequent heartbeat reporting.
Disconnect and leave events now immediately remove players from the active roster.
fixed: Fixed live server players being logged as activity without appearing in the Anti-Cheat Active Players count.

entries.title: Live Anti-Cheat Server Roster
added: Added a dedicated Active Players roster to the Developer Anti-Cheat board.
Added live server, join time, CAD account match, CIV number, and detection-status details.
changed: Current in-game presence is now separated from the historical anti-cheat player directory and website login activity.
Live players with intelligence files can be opened directly from the active roster.

entries.title: Completed Court Docket
added: Added a clearly labeled Completed docket with a live record count.
Added filing progress and explicit final-versus-active decision feedback.
changed: Final dispositions now automatically open the Completed docket after filing.
Under-review and continued matters explicitly remain on the Active docket.
fixed: Court updates now verify the saved database row before reporting success.
Finalized citations and criminal matters are guaranteed to leave the active-case status set.

entries.title: Judicial Conflict-of-Interest Locks
added: Added prominent red conflict warnings when a court official is the defendant or filing officer on a case.
Added conflict indicators to active dockets, prior decisions, appeals, and expungement petitions.
changed: Conflict records remain visible for disclosure while all judicial action controls are removed.
fixed: The backend now prevents conflicted officials from deciding, sentencing, dismissing, or ruling on related petitions.

entries.title: Developer Tools Control Update
removed: Temporarily removed the RCON server restart control and its API from Developer Tools.

entries.title: Reliable RCON Restart Dispatch
changed: The restart flow now verifies RCON authentication and command traffic before dispatching the restart.
A missing reply after restart dispatch is handled correctly because Reforger may restart before acknowledging the command.
fixed: Expanded RCON permission and command-rejection detection with actionable server errors.
Corrected the developer restart result message so a successfully dispatched restart is not reported as failed.

entries.title: Developer RCON Server Control
added: Added a developer-only live server restart control to the Dev Tools overview.
Added a protected confirmation flow requiring an operational reason and the word RESTART.
changed: Server restart commands now use the configured server-side Arma RCON connection without exposing credentials to the browser.
Successful and failed restart attempts are recorded in the staff audit log.

entries.title: Permanent Court Records & Petitions
added: Added permanent non-expunged criminal records to NCIC returns and civilian MDT profiles.
Added civilian appeal and expungement request forms in MyFaircroft.
Added a judicial Petitions docket for approving or denying post-judgment requests.
changed: Court decisions remain attached to the original CAD/NCIC case record and notify the civilian and filing officer.
Approved appeals reopen the original case for judicial review while preserving the previous decision history.
Approved expungements remove the record from operational NCIC criminal history without deleting the court audit record.
fixed: Reconnected judicial decisions to refreshed Court data and permanent operational record displays.

entries.title: Compact MDT Command Rail
added: Added direct section links from each operational rail preview.
changed: Rebuilt Quick Access as a compact command index instead of oversized stacked buttons.
The side rail now shows short BOLO, report, return, and active-only officer-alert previews.
All existing rail features remain available through their full MDT sections.
fixed: Reduced excessive side-panel length and unnecessary scrolling caused by cleared historical alerts.

entries.title: Compact Criminal Charge Catalog
changed: Criminal charge cards now use the same compact treatment as citation cards.
Desktop criminal-code results use a denser three-column grid with responsive two- and one-column breakpoints.
Long offense titles, classifications, and descriptions are constrained without removing code details.
fixed: Criminal charge cards no longer consume excessive vertical space.

entries.title: Multi-Citation Traffic Stops
added: Added searchable multi-select citation codes to the electronic UTT writer.
Added combined fine, point, code, and violation totals before filing.
changed: One traffic stop can now submit up to 12 civil violations using shared stop details.
Each selected violation creates its own linked Court filing for payment or contest.
Citation catalog cards are shorter and use compact clamped descriptions.
fixed: Officers are no longer limited to one citation per traffic stop.

entries.title: Staff Operations Ledger
added: Added a structured identity ledger for recent Arma account links.
changed: Reworked the Dev Tools Overview queue with aligned identity, Bohemia link, and readable date columns.
Replaced oversized empty cards with compact operational status rows.
fixed: Removed raw browser-style boxes and unformatted timestamps from Recent Arma Links.

entries.title: Full-Screen Court Workspace
added: Added a dedicated full-screen judicial shell with docket refresh, session status, and Court exit controls.
changed: Court now opens outside the phone frame like the MDT and uses the available desktop workspace.
Expanded the docket and case-file columns for clearer judicial review.
fixed: Removed the congested phone-width Court layout.

entries.title: Dev Tools Scroll Correction
changed: Desktop Dev Tools now uses one dedicated content scroll surface while keeping its navigation and toolbar fixed.
fixed: Removed the competing page and staff-container scrollbars from the desktop Dev Tools workspace.

entries.title: Criminal Charge Finder
added: Added instant criminal-code searching and offense-category navigation with live result counts.
changed: Criminal charges now use the same compact finder structure as citation codes instead of one continuous list.
Criminal category selections retain the existing transport and Booking handoff.

entries.title: Working Citation Categories
changed: Citation categories now wrap into a clean table-of-contents index without a native horizontal scrollbar.
fixed: Connected citation category buttons, code search, citation review updates, and Booking charge search to the active MDT binder.

entries.title: Professional Citation Writer
added: Added a structured four-stage electronic UTT filing workspace and persistent filing review.
changed: Redesigned citation issuance with restrained typography, compact official-record fields, and a dedicated violation summary.
Separated code lookup, officer statement, and final court filing into a clearer professional workflow.

entries.title: Multi-Charge Booking
added: Added searchable multi-select criminal charges to Booking intake.
Added linked charge records and a separate court case for every criminal count in one booking.
changed: Booking cards now display the complete filed charge stack and linked court case numbers.
fixed: Booking intake is no longer limited to one criminal charge.

entries.title: Citation Code Finder
added: Added instant citation searching across codes, offense names, keywords, descriptions, fines, and point values.
Added a table-of-contents category bar with live code counts and a keyboard search shortcut.
changed: Citation codes are now organized into searchable category views instead of one continuous list.

entries.title: Elite CAD Command Interface
added: Added a secured NCIC operations launchpad with direct access to citations, booking, BOLOs, and after-call reports.
Added animated system-health, secure-session, and live-terminal status treatments.
changed: Rebuilt the MDT visual hierarchy into a denser command-center interface with premium motion, panels, controls, and record transitions.
Enhanced MDT drawers and modal windows with polished spring animations while retaining the existing workflows.
fixed: Removed the oversized empty NCIC landing area that made the desktop CAD appear unfinished.

entries.title: Role-Only MDT Access
changed: Regular LEO MDT access now requires an explicitly assigned law-enforcement role, including for owners.
CID Command MDT access now requires an explicitly assigned CID or IU role, including for owners.
fixed: Owner status no longer grants automatic MDT or CID Command access.
An open MDT closes and clears CID state immediately after the account loses its qualifying role.

entries.title: Citation and Booking Separation
added: Added mandatory suspect-transport confirmation before a criminal charge can be filed through Booking.
Added recorded transport-confirmation timestamps to booking packets.
changed: Criminal charges selected from the ticket writer now continue into Booking instead of issuing a warrant.
The criminal handoff preserves the selected suspect, criminal code, arrest location, probable cause, and transport destination.
fixed: Citation issuance can no longer accept criminal charge codes.
Traffic and civil tickets no longer trigger the criminal warrant workflow.

entries.title: Indeed Icon Restoration
changed: The public Indeed Jobs icon is now protected from global application-visibility controls.
Developer accounts now retain access to the Indeed Admin recruitment desk.
fixed: Restored missing Indeed job and recruitment icons for eligible accounts.

entries.title: Anti-Cheat Intelligence
added: Added a developer-only Anti-Cheat workspace with live player presence, detection totals, event evidence, known alt-account groups, and CAD identity matching.
Added automated Shadowhaven synchronization for the existing Thunder Buddies player and alt-account JSON databases.
changed: Existing anti-cheat player sessions now report join and heartbeat presence through the established authenticated Arma event bridge.

entries.title: Beta Team Roster
added: Added a Beta Testing Team roster to Dev Tools with tester identity, CIV number, account verification, Arma-link status, and latest enrollment time.
fixed: Developers can now identify every account currently holding the Beta Tester role.

entries.title: Faircroft Beta Program
added: Added developer-controlled Beta Program recruitment campaigns with a customizable login invitation.
Added automatic Beta Tester role enrollment and a dedicated Beta Tasks app.
Added developer-published testing assignments and structured tester bug reports.
Added Beta Program membership, active-task, and report metrics inside Dev Tools.
changed: Dev Tools Settings now includes release-testing recruitment, task publishing, task closure, and tester feedback.

entries.title: Indeed Job Advertisements and Bar Exam
added: Added the Wanna Be a Lawyer advertisement with a private 20-question Faircroft Bar Exam.
Added internal exam scoring and judicial certificate signing before Licensed Attorney access is granted.
changed: Replaced the plain Indeed navigation tabs with expandable, visual job advertisements that open directly into each application.

entries.title: Business Registry Mobile Layout
fixed: Business Registry now switches all desktop grids, cards, form controls, and license folders to a single-column phone layout at the full workspace breakpoint.
Scaled mobile browser viewports can no longer force the Business Registry wider than the visible screen.

entries.title: Mobile Workspaces and Department Consolidation
changed: Indeed recruitment now offers only the Faircroft Sheriff's Office and one combined Fire & EMS application.
Approval of a combined Fire & EMS application grants access to both emergency-service roles.
fixed: Staff Operations and Business Registry now collapse desktop grids and form controls correctly on phone-sized screens.
Workspace navigation, headers, and content no longer force the mobile page wider than the viewport.

entries.title: Live RCON Enforcement
added: Added live Arma Reforger RCON commands for permanent bans, timed bans, and unbans using each linked Bohemia identity.
Added explicit Unban Player controls and game-enforcement status to Staff Operations.
changed: CAD sanctions now remain active when an RCON unban fails, preventing false unban confirmations.
fixed: Revoking a ban or timeout now sends the official #ban remove command to the game server and records the result in the audit trail.

entries.title: Faircroft Community Build Route
added: Added a Roadmap app icon for every signed-in Faircroft user.
Added MyFaircroft as the personal resident-services app for court fines, citation contests, business-tax balances, verified payment requests, and payment records.
Added Faircroft RP mandatory-minimum and guideline-maximum sentences in gameplay minutes for every criminal offense class.
Added a dedicated judicial Court workspace with active docket, case files, findings, dispositions, sentence conditions, previous decisions, and the complete RP sentencing schedule.

Added a full-screen animated Build Route with connected milestones for the PWA core, TBS RP Linking expansion, live CAD/game sync, Android APK parity, mobile banking, properties, and the connected economy.
Added PostgreSQL-backed upvotes and downvotes with one active vote per account per milestone.
Added roadmap filters, live completion telemetry, Android target countdown, build briefs, community vote scores, and responsive phone layouts.
Added owner/admin route controls for creating milestones and changing status, progress, dates, order, visibility, accent, icon, summary, and build notes.
changed: Separated personal obligations from judicial work: every signed-in resident now manages personal matters in MyFaircroft, while only judges and the owner receive the Court app.
Fine and business-tax payments now enter the existing locked Arma balance-verification workflow from the resident account instead of being marked paid before game-bank confirmation.
Judges can no longer be assigned to or preside over a case filed against their own account.
Roadmap opens outside the phone frame as a dedicated animated workspace and returns users to the phone when closed.
PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices receive the Roadmap icon, full-screen route, and dockless launcher.
Dev Tools visibility and API access are now restricted to owner and developer roles; standard admins retain their normal administrative tools without developer access.

Rebuilt the Roadmap as the Faircroft Build Route with the real Faircroft crest, State of Faircroft identity, cyan and pink brand treatment, civic gold accents, a connected five-system platform rail, and a cleaner milestone sequence.
Roadmap opening, closing, route travel, progress, filter, refresh, build-brief, vote, and scroll-reveal motion now use a coordinated animation system across desktop and mobile.
fixed: Restricted account email addresses in CAD and NCIC to owner/admin sessions; law-enforcement, CID, dispatch, fire, and EMS searches no longer receive, display, or search private login email data.
Fixed a judge's own tickets and citations appearing inside the same workspace as the official court docket.
Fixed criminal sentencing displaying real-world-style terms by replacing them with bounded Faircroft RP minute standards.
Restored Dev Tools, developer-role access, sanctions, warnings, app visibility controls, audit tools, and guided Arma unlink codes from the 0.0.70 system.
Restored the complete Arma bridge snapshot, event, game-bank sync, link/unlink routes, database tables, and Railway chunked-request handling while retaining the new Roadmap.
removed: Removed the persistent Messages, Contracts, DMV, and Court dock from the bottom of the PWA home screen; every app remains available from the main icon grid.

entries.title: MDT Arrest Booking System
added: Added a full Booking Desk inside the MDT for custodial arrest processing.
Added booking packets with generated booking numbers, arrestee records, criminal code selection, probable cause, property inventory, medical notes, holding cell, bond, court date, and officer notes.
Added active booking queue and recent release/transfer history for officers.
Added booking history to NCIC returns and the civilian MDT profile pop-up.
Added traffic-stop arrest handoff into the new Booking Desk.
changed: Criminal bookings now auto-create a linked court case using the existing criminal code catalog and notify the defendant, officer, and assigned judge when available.
The MDT navigation, side quick access, and stats strip now include Booking.

entries.title: Mobile Menu and Watch Drawer Rebuild
added: Added a dedicated mobile drawer layer for MDT Menu and Watch panels.
changed: Mobile Menu and Watch no longer use the desktop MDT sidebars or the in-grid drawer path.
The mobile drawer layer now renders as its own fixed overlay with the scrim and panel in the same stacking context.
fixed: Fixed mobile Menu and Watch buttons still opening to a blurred screen instead of a usable panel.
Fixed the NCIC/Menu drawer being trapped by MDT layout stacking and iOS fixed-position behavior.

entries.title: Mobile MDT Drawer Layer Fix
changed: Moved the mobile MDT drawer backdrop into the same layout layer as the Menu and Watch drawers so the drawer panel renders above the blur.
Disabled the mobile MDT boot transform during drawer use to avoid iOS fixed-position stacking issues.
fixed: Fixed tapping Menu/NCIC on mobile showing only a blurred MDT screen with no visible drawer.
Fixed the drawer backdrop being able to cover the Menu and Watch panels because it was rendered as a higher z-index sibling.

entries.title: Mobile Overlay and Drawer Repair
changed: Mobile MDT drawers now open as inset phone panels above the blurred backdrop instead of edge-to-edge desktop sidebars.
Mobile modal and confirmation overlays now render as visible bottom sheets with lighter blur and stronger z-index ordering.
fixed: Fixed some mobile pages showing only a blurred MDT screen when a drawer, modal, or confirm prompt was active.
Fixed Watch/Menu drawer panels being able to sit off-screen or behind the overlay on narrow iPhone views.
Fixed confirmation popups on phone screens being too easy to lose behind the dimmed background.

entries.title: Mobile MDT Layout Repair
changed: Rebuilt the phone-width MDT responsive rules so the header, command buttons, stats, and NCIC workspace fit inside the iPhone/Android viewport.
Mobile MDT now uses one compact command bar instead of showing duplicate quick-rail controls over the page.
Telemetry stats now collapse into compact two-column mobile tiles instead of giant horizontal desktop columns.
Confirmed-action popups now behave like a phone bottom sheet so they stay visible and reachable on mobile.
fixed: Fixed mobile MDT horizontal overflow that cut off Messages, NCIC search, and empty-state text.
Fixed the duplicate Dispatch/Messages/Watch quick rail covering the mobile MDT content.
Fixed oversized stat panels and header controls making the mobile MDT feel like a broken desktop page.

entries.title: Traffic Stop NCIC Workflow
added: Added an embedded NCIC / DMV search interface inside the Traffic Stop Assistant.
Officers can now attach the searched driver directly to the active traffic stop prompt.
Added a stop outcome screen with direct actions for warning/release, citation writer, criminal charge writer, and arrest protocol.
Added an arrest protocol prompt with custody sequence steps, criminal writer access, and after-call report access.
changed: Traffic Stop Assistant now requires an attached driver before moving from NCIC into enforcement actions.
Citation and criminal writer shortcuts now preselect the attached driver from the traffic stop workflow.
Traffic Stop Assistant mobile panels now use compact NCIC return cards and touch-friendly outcome buttons.
fixed: Reduced traffic-stop prompt confusion by routing officers from records check to the correct ticket, criminal charge, or arrest workflow.

entries.title: Mobile MDT and Confirmed Actions
added: Added a global confirmation popup for important system-changing requests with a small digital footprint signature.
Added duplicate-request protection so repeated taps on the same action do not send multiple submissions while the first request is pending.
changed: Reworked MDT mobile behavior for Android and iPhone with dynamic viewport height, safe-area padding, horizontal action strips, touch scrolling, compact stats, and iOS-friendly form inputs.
MDT drawers, modals, top actions, stats, and bottom quick controls now adapt better to narrow phone screens.
fixed: Fixed repeated button taps being able to send duplicate POST/PATCH/DELETE requests.
Improved MDT scrolling and layout stability on phone-sized viewports.

entries.title: Indeed Admin Application Folder Fix
changed: Opened application folders in Indeed Admin and Admin Job Apps now use the main app panel scroll instead of a nested clipped list.
Application summary fields and reviewer profile fields now wrap into responsive columns on narrow phone screens.
fixed: Fixed opened Indeed Admin applications being cut off at the bottom of the phone panel.

entries.title: Traffic Stop Protocol Assistant
added: Added a MDT Settings page for officer workflow controls.
Added a skippable Traffic Stop Assistant that walks officers through RP stop protocol from observation through documentation.
Added an Initiate Traffic Stop button in MDT Settings and the MDT watch panel.
Added a device-level setting to keep the traffic stop assistant available or pause it on that officer device.
changed: Traffic stop guidance now appears as a terminal-style overlay with progress, step navigation, next/back controls, finish, and skip actions.
The MDT watch panel now exposes traffic stop protocol access alongside Dispatch, Messages, Write Ticket, and NYS Codes.

entries.title: Officer MDT Visual Overhaul
added: Added a new law/CID MDT terminal skin with a connected command layout instead of stacked widget panels.
Added a MDT status line showing callsign, active workspace, and terminal time.
Added numbered MDT navigation controls for faster officer orientation.
changed: Reworked the officer/CID MDT shell, nav rail, telemetry strip, ticket writer, code cards, and watch panel to feel more like one modern CAD terminal.
Reduced repeated boxed-card styling across the MDT and replaced it with flatter connected panels, rail separators, and subtle command-console motion.
Added mobile-specific rules so the redesigned MDT still works with slide-out menu and watch drawers on phones.
fixed: Reduced the blocky widget look in the MDT interface while preserving the existing NCIC, ticket, BOLO, report, panic, and CID workflows.

entries.title: Indeed Admin and NYS Ticket Book
added: Added a new Indeed Admin app icon for owners, admins, and the new indeed_admin role to review department job applications.
Added the indeed_admin role to account role assignment and department application review notifications.
Added NYS VTL-style traffic, vehicle, license, insurance, equipment, and parking citation entries to the MDT citation catalog.
Added MDT ticket shortcuts for Write Ticket and NYS Codes from the watch panel and citation cards.
changed: Department application review permissions now allow the Indeed Admin role without granting full Admin account-management access.
Admin Job Apps and Indeed Admin review queues now use clearer folder-style application packets with explicit open and close controls.
The ticket writer now groups citation and criminal code dropdown options by category for faster officer selection.
fixed: Improved application packet opening behavior in the Admin Job Apps layout.
Reduced officer ticket friction by making citation writing and NYS code browsing accessible from more MDT screens.

entries.title: Court Citation Flow and Application Cleanup
added: Court now clearly labels MDT-issued citations as court cases in the docket.
Users with issued citations can open Court to pay or contest even if their civilian verification is still pending.
Court now shows active and previous docket counts in a dedicated citation/case header.
changed: Officer court dockets now use the full law-service role list, including Sheriff, Police, State Police, CID, and IU roles.
Admin Job Apps now render as compact expandable application folders instead of open review forms in a long wall.
The Jobs app now uses collapsible application packets and a compact My Application Files section.
fixed: Fixed citations not appearing for officers whose role was a department role instead of the generic LEO role.
Fixed unverified defendants being unable to access Court when they already had a citation to resolve.
Reduced Admin and Jobs panel clutter from stacked application widgets.

entries.title: Application Review Queues
added: Added an Admin Job Apps panel where owners/admins can see department applications without relying on inbox messages.
Admins can now mark department applications under review, approve them, deny them, or close them from the Admin panel.
Approved department applications now verify the account, add the requested department role, and set the agency when blank.
Admin accounts now receive Business Registry staff view access for reviewing business applications.
changed: Business Registry review now uses compact application folders with status filters instead of one long expanded list.
Business Registry recent decisions now render as dedicated registry action rows.
fixed: Fixed admins not having a visible queue for submitted job/department applications.
Reduced business application review wall clutter by hiding full plans, funding, and forms inside expandable folders.

entries.title: Referral Cash Tickets
added: Added an Admin Referral Tickets panel where owners/admins can review pending referral payouts.
Referral payouts are now held as $50,000 cash tickets until an owner/admin manually deposits them.
Admins and owners now receive inbox notifications when a referral payout ticket is created.
Referral ticket deposits create transaction history and notify the referrer after payout.
changed: Referral registration no longer auto-deposits cash into the referrer's wallet.
Profile referral stats now separate pending referral tickets from deposited referral cash.

entries.title: Referral Program
added: Added a referral code to every user profile.
New users can enter a referral code during registration.
When a referral code is used, the code owner receives a $50,000 in-game cash credit.
Profile now shows referral stats, total referral cash earned, recent referral credits, and a Copy Code button.
changed: Admin account search now also finds accounts by referral code.
Referral bonuses are recorded in the transaction ledger and message inbox.

entries.title: Admin Account Search
added: Added a live account search bar to the Admin Users panel.
Admins and owners can search accounts by name, email, CIV number, Arma ID, car entry code, callsign, agency, active character, role, or verification status.
changed: Admin account results now show a live match count and can be cleared with one button.

entries.title: Faircroft Treasury and Bank Opening
added: Added a Faircroft Treasury phone app for verified users.
Players can submit server wipe compensation requests with screenshot proof uploads.
Players without proof can check the no-proof bypass to request the standard $75,000 stimulus check.
Owner/admin review tools can approve Treasury requests and deposit approved funds directly into the player bank.
Bank now includes owner/admin Treasury deposit controls and a compensation ledger showing who has been paid.
changed: Bank is now unlocked for verified users instead of being marked coming soon.
Treasury deposits now create bank transaction records and player messages for tracking.

entries.title: Civilian Getting Started Guide
added: Added a Getting Started phone app icon for civilians.
Getting Started includes starter route steps for buying a used car, Dirty Pond money grinding, bag upgrades, Town Hall IL license, and mining prep.
Added map screenshots for Used Cars, Dirty Pond, Bag Store, Town Hall, and Hardware Store.
changed: PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the new guide and map assets.

entries.title: MDT Quick Rail Placement
changed: MDT quick action buttons now stay mobile-only as a bottom action strip.
fixed: Fixed the floating Dispatch/Messages/Watch rail covering the desktop MDT watch panel.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the corrected rail placement.

entries.title: Dispatch Button Controls
added: Dispatch selected-call updates now use direct status buttons instead of status dropdowns.
Added a Close Ticket button that closes the CAD call and moves it off the active dashboard into Past Calls.
changed: Dispatch priority updates now use button controls for standard, elevated, and critical priority.
Closed or cleared calls no longer remain pinned as the selected active dashboard call unless opened from Past Calls.
fixed: Fixed closed dispatch tickets staying visible in the main active call workspace after status changes.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the new dispatch controls.

entries.title: MDT Dispatch Rail and Callsign Fix
added: Added a floating MDT quick rail with Dispatch, Messages, and Watch actions for officers.
Department users now get a required callsign popup so dispatch can identify and assign them.
Dispatch access now recognizes Sheriff, Police, State Police, Metro Police Chief, and State Police Commander roles.
changed: Opening Dispatch or Messages from the MDT now returns officers back to the MDT when closed.
PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the fixed MDT and dispatch bundle.
fixed: Fixed a JavaScript parse error in the dispatch NCIC lookup binding that could leave the app stuck on the loading screen.
Fixed the MDT workspace referencing an undefined command variable when opening the MDT.
Updated the service worker cache to stop serving the older boot loader and stale asset URLs.

entries.title: Dispatch Past Calls Archive
added: Moved completed dispatch calls out of the main dispatch queue and into a dedicated Past Calls modal.
Added a Past Calls button that opens full-call summaries with department, times, notes, and unit counts.
Allowed opening any past call directly into CAD for review and follow-up.
changed: Main dispatch queue now stays focused on active calls while keeping historical calls available via button-open detail panel.

entries.title: Dispatch Control Center
added: Added a Dispatch app for dispatcher and owner roles.
Dispatch now opens as a full control-center CAD dashboard with call queue, call intake, selected call controls, unit assignment, and scene notes.
Dispatchers can create CAD calls, attach and detach units, update call status and priority, and post notes for active scenes.
changed: 911/Panic calls now carry call type, priority, and updated timestamps for dispatcher tracking.
PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the Dispatch app.

entries.title: Tiny OS Version Footer
added: Added a small RP OS version footer to the phone-style PWA shell.
changed: PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the footer update.

entries.title: MDT BOLO Load Guard
changed: MDT data loading now treats the BOLO feed as optional during startup so the rest of the MDT can still render if Railway is not serving the new BOLO endpoint yet.
PWA cache versioning was bumped again to force installed devices to request the newest MDT JavaScript.
fixed: A missing or stale BOLO API route can no longer block the MDT screen from loading its updated navigation.

entries.title: MDT BOLO Board
added: Added a separate BOLO tab inside the LEO/CID MDT for all active officer lookouts.
Officers can broadcast BOLOs with target details, vehicle notes, plate, last seen area, caution level, and reason.
The MDT watch panel now previews active BOLOs for faster officer awareness.
changed: MDT stat strips now include active BOLO counts.
PWA cache versioning was bumped again so installed devices pull the System Update Lockdown screen and BOLO board after deployment.
fixed: BOLOs now persist in the database and can be cleared or cancelled instead of living only as temporary screen content.

entries.title: System Update Lockdown
added: Owner System Settings now includes a System Update Lockdown mode with a custom lockdown message.
When lockdown is enabled, users see a Software Update-style phone screen.
Driver License and LEO MDT remain available during lockdown, with owner System controls preserved so lockdown can be disabled.
changed: DMV opens directly to the Driver License page during update lockdown.
The app catalog is restricted during lockdown so unavailable apps cannot be opened from the phone screen.
fixed: Vehicle registration and DMV vehicle updates are blocked while update lockdown is active.
PWA cache versioning now forces installed devices to load the update lockdown screen.

entries.title: Recruitment-Only Jobs
added: Jobs is now unlocked for signed-in users so civilians can submit department applications before verification.
changed: The Jobs app is now a recruitment/application portal only.
Admin overview now shows active department applications instead of passive job assignments.
fixed: Passive job apply and passive income collect endpoints now return disabled responses.
PWA cache versioning now forces installed devices to load the recruitment-only Jobs screen.
removed: Removed the Passive Income Jobs board from the Jobs app.
Removed passive income collection and daily requirement UI from Bank.
Removed passive Jobs and Markets tabs from the Admin panel.

entries.title: Law Enforcement Application Packets
added: Law enforcement department applications now use the full required questionnaire covering in-game name, Discord, age, department selection, experience, scenarios, and policy acknowledgements.
Added Metro Police Chief, State Police Commander, and CID Director command roles for department application routing.
Submitted law enforcement packets now include a reviewable answer preview in the Jobs app.
changed: Metro Police, State Police, Sheriff Office, and CID postings now save full structured application packets instead of a single short statement.
Department application messages now include the completed answers for command review.
fixed: Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the new law enforcement application form.

entries.title: Profile Car Entry Codes
added: Civilian registration now requires an in-game car entry code.
Existing users without a car entry code now get a blocking profile update popup after login until the code is saved.
Profile now includes a car entry code section where users can update their code.
MDT/NCIC searches now show the civilian car entry code on account returns and profile popups.
changed: Officers can search NCIC/DMV by car entry code in addition to name, email, CIV number, and plate.
fixed: Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the car entry code requirement.

entries.title: Department Jobs Portal and Fire MDT Mobile Cleanup
added: Jobs now opens as a department recruiting portal with tabs for State Police, Metro Police, Sheriff Office, CID, Fire Dept, EMS, and Dispatcher.
Players can submit saved department applications with a written statement from the Jobs app.
Department applications now receive application numbers and notify owner/admin accounts.
changed: The Jobs app is now unlocked for verified users instead of remaining a coming-soon app.
Passive income jobs now sit below the department recruiting board as the Civilian Work Board.
Fire MDT apparatus assignments now render as compact command cards instead of a tall desktop-style roster on phones.
Fire MDT header, status strip, and command controls have tighter mobile sizing.
fixed: Fire MDT now uses the current user's Fire Chief command role as a fallback when the overview cache reports read-only.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the Jobs portal and Fire MDT mobile cleanup.

entries.title: Fire Chief Command Access Fix
added: Fire command role handling now recognizes Fire Chief role aliases from older or display-form account records.
changed: Fire personnel lists now use the same normalized role checks as Fire command permissions.
fixed: Fixed Fire Chief accounts seeing read-only rig assignment controls instead of chief command controls.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the Fire Chief access fix.

entries.title: IA Folder File Logs
added: Internal Affairs folders now support investigator file entries tied to the selected IA record.
IA folders now include quick tools for evidence, interviews, command review, and findings.
Each IA file now has a chat-style file log showing author, entry type, body, and timestamp.
changed: Ongoing IA tools now live inside the selected IA folder instead of feeling like static page-level controls.
IA folder cards now show file entry counts in the folder rail and detail metrics.
fixed: Fixed IA investigations lacking a place for investigators to keep adding updates after the intake file was created.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the IA folder file log.

entries.title: Fire Settings Mobile Assignment Polish
added: Fire Settings now has a dedicated phone-native apparatus assignment layout.
Apparatus rows animate in as touch-friendly assignment cards inside the Fire Settings app.
changed: Fire Settings no longer uses the wide desktop roster layout inside the phone app panel.
Rig assignment fields, status selectors, notes, and save buttons now stack cleanly on mobile.
Fire Settings buttons and apparatus cards now have stronger hover and touch feedback.
fixed: Fixed Fire Settings cutting off role, status, notes, and action columns on phone screens.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the Fire Settings mobile layout.

entries.title: IA Folder Board and Interaction Polish
added: Internal Affairs now uses selectable IA folders instead of showing every IA file as one long board.
Active IA and previous IA files are separated in the folder rail.
New IA records automatically open the newly created IA folder.
changed: Only the selected IA file opens with full summary, metrics, and update controls.
MDT buttons now have stronger hover, focus, and press feedback.
MDT popups now animate in with a smoother fade and lift treatment.
fixed: Fixed Internal Affairs dumping all summaries and update forms into the same visible board.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the IA folder board and interaction polish.

entries.title: Fire MDT Roster Redesign and Account Deletion
added: Owner account panel now includes an owner-only delete account action for non-owner accounts.
Fire command rig assignments now use a dispatch roster layout with one column header row and operational apparatus rows.
changed: Fire MDT rig assignments no longer render as a grid of box-like mini forms.
Fire MDT command stats now display as a slimmer telemetry bar instead of chunky stat boxes.
Fire rig controls now use compact roster fields to reduce clutter on desktop while stacking cleanly on mobile.
fixed: Reduced the cramped visual layout shown when multiple battalion and apparatus assignments are visible at once.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed phones load the redesigned Fire MDT roster.

entries.title: Fire Command Settings
added: Fire command roles now include Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, and Fire Marshal.
Fire Settings app icon now appears for fire command users and owner accounts.
Fire Settings includes chief-level rig assignment controls using the same live data as Fire MDT.
Rig assignment options now include Battalion 1 through Battalion 5.
Rig positions now include Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, Fire Marshal, and Battalion Chief.
changed: Fire rig assignment control now unlocks for Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, Fire Marshal, and owner accounts.
Owner/admin account management can assign the new fire command roles.
Fire alert routing now includes Deputy Chief and Fire Marshal recipients.
fixed: Fixed Fire MDT rig assignments showing read-only for command users outside the original fire_chief role.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed phones load the new Fire Settings icon and expanded rig list.

entries.title: CAD After-Call Reports
added: MDT now includes a Reports tab for officers to file after-call incident reports.
Reports can link to a CAD/911 call, an involved civilian profile, call type, disposition, location, narrative, actions taken, and evidence or clip links.
Officers can mark calls as cleared, founded, unfounded, report taken, citation issued, arrest made, referred to CID, false alarm, or unable to locate.
Recent reports now appear in the MDT side watch panel for quick command review.
changed: Linked CAD calls are automatically cleared when an after-call report is filed as cleared, unfounded, false alarm, or unable to locate.
CAD report narratives preserve long-form text and line breaks for detailed officer documentation.
CID Command quick actions now include direct access to CAD Reports.
fixed: Officers now have a dedicated place to document incident outcomes instead of relying only on tickets, panic alerts, or court cases.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed MDT views load the new Reports tab.

entries.title: CID Command MDT
added: CID users now open into a dedicated CID Command MDT instead of a patrol-style MDT with only investigation tabs.
New CID Command dashboard with priority case watch, active warrant operations, intelligence feed, internal affairs queue, and quick action launchers.
CID-wide side intelligence panels for command tracker, priority cases, and warrant watch.
Warrant detail popup can now be opened from the CID Command dashboard, side watch, or Warrant Ops board.
changed: CID MDT shell now uses CID-specific navigation labels, command statistics, title treatment, and investigative visual styling.
Warrant Ops and Internal Affairs intake screens now use the same CID command-board layout as investigations.
CID case notes now store full text instead of being capped at the previous note length.
fixed: CID MDT no longer feels limited to a single Investigations tab; the whole module is now an investigative command system.
Non-CID users are safely returned to NCIC if an old session points at a CID-only tab.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed MDT views load the new CID Command MDT.

entries.title: CID Investigation Desk Redesign
added: Investigative MDT CID Investigations tab now has a redesigned command-desk case intake board.
CID investigation creation now includes a target civilian dropdown populated from all user profiles.
Target civilian selection auto-fills the target name while still allowing unlisted target aliases.
changed: CID investigation summaries now store full text instead of being capped at the previous short limit.
CID investigation intake layout now uses a larger long-form summary area and cleaner responsive mobile layout.
fixed: Removed the need for officers to type raw target CIV database IDs when opening CID investigations.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed MDT views load the redesigned CID tab.

entries.title: Character Profiles and Name Locking
added: Profile app now includes a character roster where players can create multiple RP characters.
Players can activate a saved character and the active character name becomes the profile name used across the PWA.
Profile app now includes a controlled active-name change form with a 3 changes per 3 days limit.
Admin Account pop-up now shows character count and name-change status.
changed: Existing accounts automatically receive a default character based on their current profile name.
Name-change limits are enforced by the backend instead of only being hidden in the UI.
fixed: Admins and owners can unlock a user's name changes from the Account pop-up after the limit locks them.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed phone views load the new Profile character tools.

entries.title: DMV License Approval Countdown
added: DMV License page now shows a visible approval queue card after a driver license application is submitted.
Pending license applications now display a countdown until automatic approval.
Countdown uses the owner-configured DMV autopilot approval time from System Settings.
changed: DMV license applications refresh automatically when their approval countdown reaches zero.
DMV API now returns license autopilot settings and estimated approval times for pending applications.
fixed: Made driver license approval visible to civilians even without a separate DMV department dashboard.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the DMV countdown page replaces older cached DMV screens.

entries.title: Profile Warrants and Fire Chief Rigs
added: NCIC/DMV searches now open a civilian profile popup with attached warrant records.
Civilian profile popup now has a Warrants tab with active and previous warrant history.
Fire Chief role for command-level Fire MDT access.
Fire Chief rig builder for assigning personnel to Engine 1, Ladder 1, Truck 1, Rescue 1, and Battalion 1.
changed: CID warrant board now uses button containers and detail popups instead of showing full warrant files on the main wall.
Served, recalled, and expired warrants move out of the active warrant board and into previous warrant history.
fixed: Fixed warrants not appearing on the searched civilian profile record.
Fixed fire alerts not recognizing a dedicated Fire Chief command role.
Updated PWA cache versioning so profile warrant and Fire Chief rig changes replace older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: Issue Criminal Charge Warrants
added: Issue Criminal Charge screen now has the civilian name/CIV dropdown directly inside the Issue form.
Issue Criminal Charge screen now includes a Bypass Court section.
Bypass Court creates an active warrant linked directly to the selected account without creating a court docket case.
changed: Criminal charge submissions from the Issue screen now sign and issue an active warrant immediately.
Criminal catalog Use Charge now opens the Issue screen with that criminal charge already selected.
fixed: Fixed the criminal charge issue flow still relying on a raw CIV ID instead of the profile dropdown.
Fixed charge warrants being available in the wrong MDT area instead of the Issue Criminal Charge section.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the corrected Issue Criminal Charge screen replaces older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: Criminal Charge Warrants
added: Criminal Charges tab now includes a charge-warrant writer with civilian profile dropdown, criminal charge selector, probable cause, priority, and optional linked CID case.
Officers can sign and issue an active warrant directly from a criminal charge.
changed: Signed charge warrants now create both a court criminal charge and a linked active warrant for the selected civilian.
fixed: Criminal charges can now be tied to warrant creation instead of only appearing as catalog entries.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the Criminal Charges warrant writer replaces older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: CID Warrant Linking
added: CID warrant creation now includes a civilian profile dropdown for selecting the warrant subject by name and CIV number.
changed: Warrants now store the selected civilian profile ID with the subject name so warrant records remain linked to the correct player profile.
fixed: Fixed warrants not attaching cleanly to civilian profiles when officers only typed a subject name.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the warrant-linking form replaces older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: DMV License Autopilot
added: Driver license auto-approval system for submitted DMV license applications.
Owner-controlled DMV autopilot settings under the System app with pending and eligible license queue counts.
MDT civilian profile popup with profile and driver license tabs.
Law enforcement driver license suspension action from the MDT license tab.
changed: Driver license applications default to auto-approval after 6 minutes when DMV autopilot is enabled.
Suspended or revoked driver licenses are protected from automatic re-approval.
fixed: Added a license approval path so DMV applications no longer remain submitted forever when no admin review screen exists.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the CID investigation folder interface replaces older MDT layouts on mobile.

entries.title: System Autopilot Controls
added: Owner-only System Settings app icon.
Auto pilot verification mode for automatically verifying civilian accounts after a configurable waiting period.
System queue stats showing pending accounts and accounts eligible for auto-verification.
Fire Department MDT for fireman and EMS roles with active 911 incident tracking.
Fireman role option in account role assignment.
changed: Default auto-verification wait time starts at 120 minutes and can be adjusted by the owner.
911 emergency alerting now supports Police, Fire, and EMS department selection.
fixed: Updated PWA cache versioning so new app modules like Fire MDT load after deployment instead of using stale mobile bundles.

entries.title: Initial Roleplay PWA System
added: Mobile PWA phone dashboard with app-style icons, locked/unlocked app states, dock shortcuts, and smoother mobile OS visual styling.
Civilian registration with required Arma ID, generated six-digit CIV number, verification flow, and owner/admin account management.
Read-only Changelog app loaded from the GitHub-managed repository file.
DMV app with driver license applications, vehicle registration, plate/VIN records, insurance status, and DMV profile display.
Automatic DMV VIN generation when civilians register vehicles.
Messages app unlocked for verified users.
Admin dashboard with compact account list, account popup, role assignment, verification controls, Arma ID visibility, job settings, market caps, and owner/admin password reset.
MDT/CAD app for owner and assigned LEO/CID roles with NCIC/DMV search, invalid-return notice popup, citation writer, criminal charge writer, panic button, and active alert watch list.
Owner-only panic alert clearing from the MDT panic screen.
Separate MDT citation and criminal charge catalogs, including New York Penal Law criminal charge entries.
Court system with active/previous case tabs, defendant case view, officer case tracking, judge docket, final result display, and auto-generated court dates.
CID investigative MDT tools with investigation tracking, case notes, warrant operations, and internal affairs records.
Civilian Contracts app with anonymous open contract board, accept flow, owner read-only monitoring, and required in-game proof clip URL submission.

Business Registry app with civilian business applications, registrar review workflow, license issuance, staff inspections, violations, suspensions, revocations, weekly tax settings, reputation scores, and dedicated City Hall/economy roles.
changed: Contracts app now uses a dark web-style phone interface with first-open instructions.
Contract posting now targets RP character names only and no longer accepts email lookup.
Contracts now include target type, last-known area, briefing, and completion requirement details.
Only pure civilian accounts can post or accept contracts; owner remains monitor-only.
Home screen no longer shows pending income or tracked server minutes.
Jobs, Bank, Cash App, and Properties remain locked/coming soon while Messages is available.
Admin access no longer automatically grants MDT, CID, LEO, or judge access.
Admin account role assignment now includes business_owner, business_registrar, city_hall, and economy_manager roles for business registry access.
Business applications now show a dynamic approval progress tracker from submitted to review, interview, and final decision.
Profile now shows account details only while external linking is paused for verification.
Court tabs only appear when the user has the matching role or owner override.
MDT opens as a full law enforcement dashboard instead of staying confined to the phone panel.
Mobile MDT now uses animated Menu and Watch slide-out drawers so officers can navigate without the tabs crushing the screen.
Phone icons, dock, and home layout were restyled to feel more like an iPhone/Android app launcher.
fixed: Fixed PostgreSQL LIKE migration crash by parameterizing the traffic citation pattern.
Fixed low-contrast MDT charge dropdown styling.
Fixed NCIC/DMV search empty results by showing an official invalid-return notice with a reference number.
Fixed admin user page overload by moving account details and actions into a popup.
Fixed role leakage where admin accounts were being treated like owner accounts for MDT/CID/LEO/judge access.
Fixed panic alert workflow so owners can clear active panic hits.
Fixed mobile MDT layout collisions where navigation, watch panels, and form controls stacked into an unreadable phone view.
removed: Removed the unlocked-home income summary card from the main screen.
Removed owner/admin edit or delete controls from the Changelog app; changelog content is developer-managed through the repository.
